title: 🚀 Google Takes AI to Space!
body: Google chose Blue Origin’s New Glenn rocket to launch satellites carrying AI computers into space in the first quarter of 2029.
The idea, simply put: run AI in space on solar power, instead of consuming the Earth’s electricity, land, and cooling systems.
Each satellite carries Google’s own chips, with computing power equal to a full server rack in a data center, and will orbit in a path that stays in sunlight almost constantly.
Can you believe data centers will fly into space? And why?
